author: VaughnKiid
quote: The GREATEST Metal Gear game. The story was impeccable with incredible depth. I got used to the clunky controls after a while, there wasn’t a single instance in the game where I thought I was getting bored or wanted to stop playing. A lot of what Kojima was trying to portray in the game has actually come to reality in 2026. Safe to say that Hideo Kojima is almost always ahead of his time. An easy 10/10. Iconic.
